routeArtifactAcceptance.requirements: The acceptance assembler emits one row per route artifact with current on-disk SHA/page binding, deterministicRebuild (which may be NOT_MEASURED), routeScopedCompleteness, rasterAcceptance, and independentVerification.pending. actualStatusPredicate.rasterState: A row reads RASTER_PASS only from an exact route receipt (or an exact applicable one-route family receipt); absent receipt yields RASTER_PENDING.
actualStatusPredicate.independentState: Every emitted row sets independentVerification.pending=true. No route-terminal conversion is implemented by this consumer.

routeArtifactCompleteness.requirements: The verifier measures route bytes/component membership/read-back and nine counters. Its result is builder-side evidence and is not itself independent verification or a raster/terminal verdict.
